footnote_text: The 990 Series C MuniFund Preferred Shares (the "MFP Shares") shown as disposed of in Table I represent MFP Shares of the Issuer that, immediately prior to the transaction date specified above, were indirectly beneficially owned by JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association ("JPMCB") by way of JPMCB's ownership of that certain National Finance Authority Certificates Series 2026-PS2 Class A Certificate (the "NFA Class A Certificate"), which represents an indirect beneficial ownership interest in the MFP Shares.  On the transaction date specified above, JPMCB deposited the NFA Class A Certificate into a trust designated as the JPM PD Series 5125 (the "Trust"). JPMCB, as a beneficiary of the Trust and through its contractual rights, retains an indirect beneficial ownership interest in the NFA Class A Certificate.
